sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-302.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 302 was established by Ordinance No. 20109, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 26, 1988. Ordinance No. 20109 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 20109 was amended by Ordinance No. 20509, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 8, 1989. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 20109; 20509; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-302.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 302 is established on property generally bounded by Skillman Street, Larmanda Street, Abrams Road, and the H. & T.C. Railroad. The size of PD 302 is approximately 14.6002 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20109; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-302.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-302.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 302A). (Ord. Nos. 20109; 25850)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-302.105. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

Landscaping must be installed in conformance with the landscape plan (Exhibit 302B) within six months after a certificate of occupancy is issued on the Property. All plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 20109; 25850)

sections.title: Uses And Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-302.106. USES AND DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

(a) Uses. The only uses permitted are those allowed in a community retail district as defined in the Dallas Development Code, except that a bar, lounge, or tavern use is not permitted.

(b) Floor area. A maximum of 175,000 square feet of floor area is permitted on the Property.

(c) Lot coverage. Maximum permitted lot coverage is 45 percent.

(d) Height.

(1) Residential proximity slope. If any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion may not be located above a residential proximity slope. Exception: Structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project through the slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less.

(2) Maximum height. Unless further restricted under Paragraph (1), maximum permitted height is 54 feet.

(e) Stories. Maximum number of stories is two.

(f) Setbacks. Setbacks are as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 20109; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-302.107. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking on the Property must be provided for each use in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 20109; 25850)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-302.108. PAVING.

All aisles, maneuvering areas, parking spaces, and emergency access ways must be surfaced subject to the approval of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 20109; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-302.109. SIGNS.

(a) General application. All signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Section 51A-7.300.

(b) Non-premise signs. Non-premise signs are prohibited. For purposes of this subsection, the entire PD is considered the premise. Section 51A-7.209, “Signs Displaying Noncommercial Messages,” and Section 51A-7.705, “Determination of Noncommercial Messages,” apply in this PD. (Ord. Nos. 20509; 25850)

sections.title: Phasing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-302.110. PHASING.

No building permit may be issued prior to January 1, 1989, and no certificate of occupancy may be issued prior to January 1, 1990 on the Property in excess of 30,000 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 20109; 25850)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-302.111. SUBDIVISION PLAT.

A subdivision plat must be filed for record with the county prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any use on the Property. (Ord. Nos. 20109; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-302.112. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Development of the Property must comply with the requirements of all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20109; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-302.113. ZONING MAP.

PD 302 is located on Zoning Map Nos. F-8, F-9, G-8, and G-9. (Ord. Nos. 20109; 25850)
